title: 10 Defaults a Godly Man Sets Before His Impulses Get a Vote
caption:
Most of your worst decisions get made at 11 PM, tired, alone, by the version of you with the least self-control.

So don’t let him decide. A godly man settles it on the strong day: the alarm across the room, the giving that leaves first, the filter, the route home that doesn’t pass it. By the time the impulse shows up, the vote is already over.

“Make no provision for the flesh.” Romans 13:14

Pick one and set it up today.

#faith #godlyman #selfcontrol #discipline #christianmen
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
